items.claim: Keep the previous context when a middleware overwrites it with a nullish value. A middleware returns `opts.next({ ctx: cond ? { user } : undefined })`, or passes a `| null` value, and a later middleware or the resolver reads a field of `ctx`.
items.consequence: At the merge-base the downstream `ctx` type was `{ ...prev, user } | prev`, matching the runtime merge `{ ...callOpts.ctx, ...nextOpts.ctx }`, which never yields a nullish value; at head it is `{ ...prev, user } | undefined`, so reads that compiled before now fail with TS18048/TS18047 although runtime behaviour is unchanged. Only nullable context overwrites are affected.
items.proposed_fix: In the non-object `TWith` arms of `Overwrite` (lines 21-24 and 26-29), return `TType` when the distributed `TWith` member is `null` or `undefined`, for example `TWith extends null | undefined ? TType : TWith`, or document that nullish context overwrites are unsupported.

items.claim: Remove the unreachable `: TType` arm and fix the `never` doc sentence. A reader of the exported `Overwrite` type relies on the comment "unless TWith is never" or on the `: TType` arm to expect `TType` back for a `never` overwrite.
items.consequence: `TWith extends any ? TWith : TType` distributes over the naked parameter, so a `never` argument becomes `never` before either arm is chosen: `Overwrite<string, never>` and `Overwrite<{ a: 1 }, never>` are both `never`, the arm is dead, and the sibling arm at line 24 already says `never` for the same case. The comment and code describe behaviour the type does not have.
items.proposed_fix: Collapse lines 25-29 to `: TWith` and reword lines 8-9 to say a `never` `TWith` yields `never`; if `TType` is intended for `never`, use the non-distributive check `[TWith] extends [never] ? TType : TWith` instead.

If every reported shape is among the demonstrated changes, the ledger closes as met and the decision becomes Approved with the two consider findings; a reported shape outside them would add a partial requirement row and reopen as a requirement finding.
items.proposed_fix: The maintainers or the orchestrator supply the text of issue #5020 (and link it from the PR body). Its reported shapes are compared against the three demonstrated changes above.

items.consequence: scratch probe2.ts: no diagnostic against the merge-base source; against head `Type '"force-error-In"' is not assignable to type 'void | { q: string; } | { q: string; } | undefined'`.
